summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and thin ignite adapters for the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers, per the spec. Changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32, renamed output_path to output_dir in the three example/integration callers, and updated the classification handler test to pass filename. Added tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Nothing was executed: tests and flake8 were not run, per the instruction not to run repository code, so line lengths, trailing newlines, and continuation alignment were checked by grep only. No commits were made.
